title: Chapter whereby is opened the place wherein Thoth resteth

verses.t: Chapter whereby is opened the place wherein Thoth resteth.
I am the Dread one in Storm, who guard the Great one against assault.
I smite like the Flint-god: I sprinkle like the Sprinkling-god.
I am the protection of the Great one against assault and I give vigour to the sword which is in the hand of Thoth in the storm.
